Welcome to the SBDI part of the [first in-person Swedish Metabarcoding Network (SMN) meeting & hands-on workshop](https://metabarcoding.se/meeting-2026/){target="_blank"}, Uppsala, 8–9 December 2026! This tutorial demonstrates how eDNA/metabarcoding data can be accessed, processed and analysed within the [Swedish Biodiversity Data Infrastructure (SBDI)](https://biodiversitydata.se/){target="_blank"} — from data submission and processing through to exploring arthropod biodiversity patterns across Swedish habitat types, using COI metabarcoding data from the [Insect Biome Atlas](https://www.insectbiomeatlas.org/){target="_blank"}.

## Agenda

- Introduction: SBDI's eDNA tools and workflows (15 min; [slides](slides-intro.pdf){target="_blank"})
- [Hands-on tutorial](tutorial.qmd): Analyse ASV portal data with R (1 h)

## Instructors
- Dr. Maria Prager — SBDI & University of Gothenburg
- Dr. Tobias Andermann — SBDI & Uppsala University
